The material held here is thin and internally inconsistent. The website text describes Dexus, an Australasian real asset investment and funds management business, not DXC Technology Co. Per that text, Dexus describes four decades of expertise in real asset investment, funds management, asset management and development, and says it combines capital and capability across a multi-billion dollar portfolio. It states that Dexus Funds Management Limited (ACN 060 920 783, AFSL No. 238163) is the responsible entity of Dexus (ASX: DXS) and the issuer of stapled securities in the Fund, which comprises two registered schemes, Dexus Property Trust (ARSN 648 526 470) and Dexus Operations Trust (ARSN 110 521 223). The site also carries standard disclaimers that past performance is not a reliable indicator of future performance and that the information is general only.

The held facts identify the company as DXC Technology Co, a for-profit public company headquartered in Ashburn, VA, with ticker DXC and SEC CIK 0001688568. No products, lawsuits, or MCP servers are recorded for it. Its recorded law exposure is in Virginia, with a count of 152.

No AI products or AI positioning appear anywhere in the supplied material, so none can be reported.
